description.value: Cactus Club Cafe Abbotsford is an upscale casual chain restaurant set on Delair Road just minutes from Highway 1, offering chef-driven international cuisine in a stylish lounge and patio setting with Fraser Valley views. It is a substantial sit-down destination rather than a quick-service stop, with a full bar, private dining rooms, and an extensive menu spanning sushi, steaks, pasta, and handhelds.

address.value: Unit B – 34650 Delair Road, Abbotsford, British Columbia
